description: This file defines the Sum class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing multiple summation functions such as sumIgnoringStrings, sumErroringStrings, and product, used for calculations similar to Excel's SUM and SUMPRODUCT functions.

classes.name: Sum
classes.description: Provides static methods to perform summation operations, including sum ignoring or erroring on non-numeric strings, and a product calculation similar to Excel's SUMPRODUCT.

methods.name: sumIgnoringStrings
methods.description: Calculates the sum of input values, ignoring non-numeric and error strings. Used for summing values while skipping invalid entries, similar to part of Excel SUM functionality.

methods.name: sumErroringStrings
methods.description: Calculates the sum of input values, returning errors if non-numeric, non-error values are encountered. Used by Excel SUM to handle errors explicitly.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Calculates the product of multiple input arrays or values, similar to Excel's SUMPRODUCT function, returning an error if array sizes mismatch.
